subject.title: fix: serialize outbound deliveries per channel+recipient

question: Should maintainers sponsor a repaired canonical-lane version of PR #44143, or leave this draft waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug and Telegram proof are strong, but the current branch is draft and needs non-trivial owner-boundary repair around lane derivation and stalled sends before it can land.

options.title: Repair Before Merge
options.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh Telegram proof.

options.title: Wait For Author
options.body: Keep the PR open but require the contributor to rebase and address the existing findings before another merge-readiness review.

options.title: Replace The Draft
options.body: If the source branch remains conflicting or inactive, open a narrow maintainer-owned replacement that credits this PR and closes it only after replacement exists.

recommendation.title: Repair Before Merge
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing keyed queue helper, derive canonical lane identity before queue and platform work, add stall and abort handling, and refresh Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available routing candidate from keyed queue cleanup and adjacent channel/outbound runtime history.
